title: Other inspection fees.
officialText:
See Table 28-112.7.3.

Table 28-112.7.3

Inspection Type

Filing Fee

Renewal Fee

Comments

Each inspection of a temporary amusement device

$130

Marquee inspection.

$15 annually for each one hundred square feet or fraction thereof.

Place of assembly inspection, including following a violation.

$130 each inspection, each place of assembly.

Search inspection of a building with a frontage of 25 feet or less and a depth of one hundred feet or less.

$20 for each floor for the first three floors;$10 for each additional floor;$130 minimum total.

A basement or a cellar shall count as a floor. Where both a basement and a cellar exist, the cellar shall not count as a floor in computing fee.

· Additional fee for building with frontage exceeding 25 feet.

Increase above fee by 40% for each floor for each additional 25 feet or fraction thereof.

· Additional fee for building with depth exceeding 100 feet.

Increase above fee by 25% for each floor for each additional 25 feet or fraction thereof.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
